Rashi on Chullin 45a:10:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן אמרוה קמיה דרבי יוחנן משמיה דרבי יונתן הכי - ולא גרסינן איכא דאמרי:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:10:1.english: This is the text we read: "They said this before Rabbi Yoḥanan in the name of Rabbi Yonatan: Thus" - And we do not read: "Some say."

Rashi on Chullin 45a:10:2.hebrew: הכי - כדקאמר רבי יוחנן: ״משהו למעלה ומשהו למטה״ — אמרוה קמיה משמיה דרבי יונתן:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:10:2.english: Thus - Just as Rabbi Yoḥanan said: “Any amount above and any amount below” — [so] they stated it before him in the name of Rabbi Yonatan.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:10:3.english: Our Babylonian colleagues - Rabbi Yonatan had ascended [to the Land of Israel] from Babylonia.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:10:4.english: In accordance with this explanation - He said [this] in praise:

Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:1.hebrew: מטבעת הגדולה - כרבי יוסי ברבי יהודה ומחלוקתו בפ"ק (לעיל חולין דף יח.) נקט לה. מיהו, אנן קיימא לן כרבי חנינא בן אנטיגנוס, דמשפוי כובע ולמטה כשרה, דהיינו למעלה מן הטבעת:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:1.english: From the large ring - [Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Yosef] formulated this in accordance with Rabbi Yosei bar Rabbi Yehuda and his disputants in the first chapter (above, Chullin 18a). However, we maintain in accordance with Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus that from the slope of the “helmet” [the thyroid cartilage] and downward it is valid, which is above the [large] ring.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:2.english: The wings of the lung - The lobes of the lung.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:3.hebrew: התחתונה - כדמפרש רבא: תחתונה — כשהבהמה תלויה, דהיינו אונות קטנות; שהיא עליונה — כשאוחזין בקנה והריאה תלויה למטה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:3.english: The lower - As Rava explains: [It is called] “lower” when the animal is suspended, which refers to the small lobes; “which is upper” [is] when one holds the windpipe and the lung hangs downward.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:4.hebrew: כנפי - כמות שהן נמתחין ופורשין כנפים למעלה, אע"פ שהקנה יורד ביניהם עד מקום חיבורן:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:4.english: [The] wings [of] - As they stretch out and spread [their] wings upward, even though the windpipe descends between them until the place of their attachment.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:5.hebrew: שאני אומר כל שפושטת צוארה ורועה - ולא יותר. לכך אני מפרש: תחתונה שהיא עליונה — שלא תאמר תחתונה כשאוחזין הקנה, דהיינו כנגד כל הריאה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:5.english: As I say: All that it extends its neck and grazes - And no more. Therefore, I explain [the phrase] "the lower, which is the upper," so that you do not say [it means] the lower [edge] when holding the windpipe, which would be opposite the entire lung.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:11:6.english: Provided that it is not forced - To pull the simanim [the organs of slaughter] outside the chest by human hands.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:12:1.hebrew: אנסה עצמה - לפשוט מאד צוארה בשעת שחיטה, מהו:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:12:1.english: [If] it forced itself - To stretch out its neck very much at the time of slaughter, what is [the law]?

Rashi on Chullin 45a:12:2.english: It stands unresolved - And [it is resolved] stringently, and such is the halakha.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:12:3.english: Below the breast - In a place that is not fit for slaughter.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:12:4.hebrew: נידון כריאה - בנקב משהו, ולא ברוב כגרגרת:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:12:4.english: It is considered like a lung - [It is rendered a tereifa] with a perforation of any size, and not [only] with the majority [severed], like the windpipe.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:13:1.hebrew: ת"ר איזהו חזה - לגבי חזה ושוק של שלמים, הניתן לכהנים:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:13:1.english: The Sages taught: Which is the breast - [This is taught] regarding the breast and thigh of peace offerings, which are given to the priests.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:13:2.hebrew: הרואה את הקרקע - אינו משבר מן הצלעות בגובה הצדדין כלום, אלא השומן התחתון כמות שהוא, בחסחוס שבראשי הצלעות:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:13:2.english: That faces the ground - He does not break off anything from the ribs along the height of the sides, but rather [takes] the lower fat as it is, with the cartilage that is at the tips of the ribs.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:13:3.hebrew: למעלה עד הכרס וכו' - ושיעור ארכו: למעלה — עד הכרס. כשהבהמה תלויה להפשיט היו נוטלים אותו, וחותך ב' צלעות הקטנות העליונות עמו משתי דפנות — אחד מכאן ואחד מכאן — והן שסביב הקנה, ונקראין פורציל"א:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:13:3.english: Above until the rumen, etc. - And the measure of its length [is]: upward — until the rumen. When the animal was hanging to be flayed, they would remove it. And one cuts the two small, uppermost ribs with it from the two sides — one from here and one from there — and they are [the ribs] that surround the windpipe, and they are called *forcelle* [fork-bones].

Rashi on Chullin 45a:14:1.english: The upper membrane - Which is attached to the skull from within.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:14:2.hebrew: ואע"ג דלא אינקיב תתאה - הקרום הרך שהמוח מונח בתוכו:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:14:2.english: And even if the lower [membrane] was not perforated - The soft membrane in which the brain rests.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:14:3.hebrew: חייתא - שק, כמו (ב"מ דף יד:) חייתא דקיטרי:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:14:3.english: The bag - A sack, as in (Bava Metzia 14b): “A bag of knots.”

Rashi on Chullin 45a:14:4.english: In which the brain rests - That the brain rests within it.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:1.hebrew: כנגדו בביצים ניכר - בביצי זכר אתה יכול להכיר רביצת המוח, שגם להן יש שני קרומים לבד הכיס: והאחד חיצון, ואחד שהביצים מונחים בו. ומתוך שקרום התחתון של מוח דק מאד ואין ניכר לגמרי, ונראה כמוח עצמו — הוא נותן לו סימן בביצים:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:1.english: Its equivalent in the testicles is conspicuous - In the testicles of a male, you can discern the resting of the brain [in its membranes], for they too have two membranes aside from the scrotum: one outer, and one in which the testicles rest. And because the lower membrane of the brain is very thin and is not entirely discernible, and appears like the brain itself, he gives him an identifying sign in the testicles.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:2.hebrew: כל מה שבקדרה - בגולגולת, עד שלא התחיל לצאת מן הקדרה ליעשות חוט, שהרי חוט השדרה מן המוח הוא בא:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:2.english: Everything that is in the pot - In the skull, before it has begun to emerge from the pot to become a cord, for the spinal cord comes from the brain.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:3.english: Is considered like the brain - [In that it renders the animal a tereifah] with a perforation of any size:

Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:4.english: To be extended - To emerge from the skull toward the side of the [spinal] cord.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:15:5.english: Is considered like the [spinal] cord - With regard to the severing of the majority [to render the animal a tereifah].

Rashi on Chullin 45a:1:1.hebrew: אתייקורי מתייקרי בי - נכבדין הם במה שאני סועד אצלם, והנאתם היא, ואין זו מתנה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:1:1.english: They are honored through me - They are honored by the fact that I dine with them, and it is their benefit, and this is not [considered] a gift.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:2:1.hebrew: כנפה - הגרגרת, סביב סביב להיקפה, נקבים דקים כנפה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:2:1.english: Like a sieve - [That is, if] the windpipe [is perforated] all around its circumference [with] fine holes like a sieve.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:2:2.hebrew: מצטרפין הנקבים לרובא - אילו היו כולן מחוברים יחד, היה רובא נפסק — טרפה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:2:2.english: The perforations join together to [constitute] a majority - If they were all joined together, the majority would be severed — [it is] a tereifah.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:3:1.hebrew: ובגולגולת - לגבי אהל המת תניא (אהלות פ"ב משנה ג), בההיא ד"כמה חסרון בשדרה", קתני סיפא: "ובגולגולת — כדי שינטל מן החי וימות", הוי חסרון, ולא מטמא. ואמרינן בבכורות (דף לח.): "כמה ינטל מן החי וימות? כמלא מקדח של רופאים". ותני עלה, דאם יש בו נקב אחד ארוך שאין עגול, רואים אותו: אם יתנו ארכו לעגלו והוי כמלא מקדח — הוי חסרון; או אפילו יש בו נקבים קטנים הרבה — כולן מצטרפין לכמלא מקדח:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:3:1.english: And in a skull - With regard to tent [impurity] of a corpse, it is taught (Oholot 2:3), in that [mishnah] regarding “How much is a deficiency in the spine?”, the latter clause teaches: “And in a skull — [an amount] such that [if] it were removed from a living [person], he would die” — [this] constitutes a deficiency, and it does not impart [tent] impurity. And we say in Bekhorot (38a): “How much [may be] removed from a living [person] and he would die? The full size of a physicians' drill.” And it is taught concerning it, that if it has one long hole that is not round, we evaluate it: if they were to shape its length into its circumference and it would be the full size of a drill [hole], it constitutes a deficiency; or even if it has many small holes, they all combine to [the size of] a full drill [hole].

Rashi on Chullin 45a:3:2.hebrew: אלמא כיון - דשיעור חסרון גולגולת כמלא מקדח הוא, מצטרפין נקבים הקטנים לכמלא מקדח, כאילו הוי חד נקב, ולא יהבינן בהו שיעורא אחרינא:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:3:2.english: Evidently, since - Since the [requisite] measure of a deficiency in a skull is the size of a drill hole, the small holes join together to [constitute] the size of a drill hole, as if it were a single hole, and we do not apply another measure to them.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:3:3.hebrew: והכא נמי - אע"ג דבפסוקות שיעורא לרובא, גבי נקובה תנן במתניתין (לקמן חולין דף נד.): "עד כמה תחסר? עד כאיסר האיטלקי". אלמא נקב הקנה טריפתו בכאיסר, וגבי נקבים קטנים בעי כאיסר לשעורינהו:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:3:3.english: And here, too - Even though regarding severed [windpipes] the measure is a majority [of the circumference], regarding a perforated [windpipe] we learned in our Mishnah (below, Chullin 54a): "How much may it be deficient? Up to an Italian issar." Evidently, a perforation of the windpipe renders [the animal] a tereifah with [the measure of] an issar, and regarding small perforations, it should require [the measure of] an issar to measure them.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:4:1.english: It escaped him - [This refers to] this questioner.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:4:2.hebrew: מצטרפין לרובא - דהוו כפסיקה בעלמא, דלא מיחסרא. וניקבה כנפה נמי — בדליכא חסרון:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:4:2.english: Join together to [constitute] a majority - For they are like a mere severance, in which nothing is missing; and [the case where] "it was perforated like a sieve" is also where there is no deficiency.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:5:1.hebrew: ניטלה הימנה רצועה - לארכה, דאיכא חסרון:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:5:1.english: A strip was removed from it - Along its length, where there is a deficiency [of tissue].

Rashi on Chullin 45a:5:2.hebrew: מצטרפת לכאיסר - אי כי מעגלת לה הויא איסר, טרפה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:5:2.english: Joins to [the size of] an issar - If, when you round it [into a circle], it is [the size of] an issar, [the animal is] a tereifa.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:6:1.hebrew: בעופא - נקבים דחסרון בעוף, דליכא למימר בגרגרת דידיה כאיסר — בכמה הוי שיעוריה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:6:1.english: With regard to a bird - [Regarding] perforations involving a deficiency [of flesh] in a bird, where one cannot say [that the measure] in its windpipe is like an issar — what is its measure?

Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:1.hebrew: מקפלו - חותך למטה מן הנקבים ובצדיהם, עד שיוכל לקפל הרצועה שהן בה כלפי פי הקנה, ומניחו למקום הנקבים ע"פ הקנה:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:1.english: Folds it - He cuts below the perforations and at their sides, until he can fold the strip that they are in toward the opening of the windpipe, and he places the site of the perforations over the opening of the windpipe.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:2.hebrew: אם חופה - בין הנקבים והשלם שבין נקב לנקב את רוב הקנה, אע"ג דבנקבים גרידי ליכא רובא:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:2.english: If it covers - [Meaning, if] both the perforations and the intact [tissue] between perforation and perforation [cover] the majority of the windpipe, even though in the perforations alone there is not a majority.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:3.hebrew: טריפה - הואיל ויש בהן חסרון, ושיעור סמיכת נקבים זה לזה כנפה, דהא אניקבה כנפה קיימינן:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:3.english: [It is] a tereifa - Since there is a deficiency [of tissue] in them, and the degree of proximity of the perforations to one another is like [that of] a sieve, for behold, we are dealing with [the case of] “it was perforated like a sieve.”

Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:4.hebrew: וסימניך - שלא תשכח שמועה זו, ולא תימא כאיסר או מצטרפין לרובא:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:4.english: And your mnemonic - So that you do not forget this teaching, and do not say [that the measure is] like an issar or [that the holes] join together to [constitute] a majority.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:5.hebrew: נפיא - כעין שעושין הנפה, שמניחין שם יריעות זנב הסוס על פי העוגל. וזה סימן יהא לך: "נקבה כנפה" שאלת, ומעשה נפה השיבוך:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:7:5.english: A sieve - Similar to the way they make a sieve, where they place sheets of horsehair over the opening of the hoop. And this shall be a mnemonic for you: You asked [about a windpipe that] “was perforated like a sieve,” and they answered you [with] the making of a sieve.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:1.hebrew: נפחתה כמין דלת - ולא נטל הפחת, אלא תלוי ועומד זקוף שם, כעין דלת במזוזתו:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:1.english: [If] it was breached like a kind of door - And the [tissue of the] breach was not removed, but rather hangs and stands upright there, like a door on its doorpost.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:2.hebrew: כדי שיכנס איסר לרחבו - ושיעור גדול הוא זה מאיסר, דהכא בעינן נכנס ויוצא, משום דאין כאן חסרון, והדלת סותם את הנקב:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:2.english: So that an issar can enter widthwise - And this is a larger measure than [the standard measure of] an issar, for here we require [that the coin be able to] enter and exit, because there is no deficiency [of tissue] here, and the door closes the hole.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:3.hebrew: נסדקה - לארכה. וקילא מכולהו — דהיכא דנפסק לרחבה ברובא, מתוך שהריאה מושכת למטה והצואר מושך למעלה, ניתק והולך לגמרי, ולא הדר חלים (שולדר"א בלע"ז). אבל לארכה, כל כמה שהצואר נמשך, הסדק סוגר והולך; הלכך, הדר חלים:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:3.english: Was cracked - Along its length. And [this case] is more lenient than all of them: for where [the windpipe] was severed across most of its width, since the lung pulls downward and the neck pulls upward, it tears progressively until completely severed, and it does not heal again (soudure [knitting together] in Old French). But along its length, as much as the neck stretches, the crack closes up progressively; therefore, it heals again.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:4.hebrew: חוליא - טבעת, שמעתי. ובעיני נראה שהן שלש טבעות, כדאמרינן במנחות (דף לט.): כדי שיכרוך וישנה וישלש הויא חוליא לגבי ציצית:
Rashi on Chullin 45a:8:4.english: A segment [ḥulya] - I heard [it explained as a single] ring. But in my view, it appears that they are three rings, as we say in Menachot (39a): [A length] so that one winds, repeats, and triples [the winding] is a ḥulya with regard to tzitzit.

Rashi on Chullin 45a:9:1.english: What is [this] segment and what is [that] segment - Why do you need these segments that Rav stated?

Tosafot on Chullin 45a:12:1.english: "[If] it forced itself" - That it extended its head excessively to take vegetables in a pit.

Tosafot on Chullin 45a:13:1.hebrew: חותך שתי צלעות מכאן ומכאן - פירש ר"ח: שתים מכאן ושתים מכאן. והאי חזה לא הוי כההוא דמסכת תמיד (דף לא.), שלא היו שם שום צלעות, כדתנן בפ' לא היו כופתין:
Tosafot on Chullin 45a:13:1.english: “One cuts two ribs from here and from there” - Rabbeinu Ḥananel explained: Two from here and two from there. And this breast is not like that breast of tractate Tamid (31a), where there were no ribs there at all, as we learned in the chapter entitled Lo Hayu Koftin:

Tosafot on Chullin 45a:3:1.hebrew: מצטרפין לכמלא מקדח - לאו משום דבעו למיסתם כב"ש, אלא משום דב"ש פירשו שיעור — נקט שיעורא דב"ש:
Tosafot on Chullin 45a:3:1.english: They join together to [the size of] a full drill hole - [This is] not because they wanted to rule anonymously in accordance with Beit Shammai; rather, because Beit Shammai specified [an explicit] measure, [the baraita] cited the measure of Beit Shammai.

Tosafot on Chullin 45a:4:1.hebrew: אישתמיטתיה הא דאמר כו' - ס"ד דרב ירמיה, דאפילו בנקבים שיש בהם חסרון קאמר דמצטרפין לרובה, מדנקט "כנפה", דמשמע: כנקבי נפה שיש בהם חסרון איירי. ומסיק: דבשאין בהן חסרון איירי, ולא נקט "נפה" אלא לומר דמלאה נקבים כנפה. ולשון "אישתמיטתי'" קשה:
Tosafot on Chullin 45a:4:1.english: "It escaped him that which Rav said, etc." - It occurred to Rav Yirmeya that even regarding perforations that involve a deficiency, Rav was saying that they join together to constitute a majority, since he stated "like a sieve," which implies that he is dealing with holes like the perforations of a sieve, which involve a deficiency. And the Gemara concludes that he is dealing with perforations that do not involve a deficiency, and he stated "sieve" only to say that it is full of perforations like a sieve. And the phrasing "it escaped him" is difficult.

Tosafot on Chullin 45a:5:1.hebrew: ניטלה ממנה רצועה מצטרפת לכאיסר - תימה: לישמועינן ניקבה, וכ"ש רצועה:
Tosafot on Chullin 45a:5:1.english: If a strip was removed from it, it joins to [the size of] an issar - It is puzzling: Let [Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi] teach us [the case where it] was perforated, and all the more so [in the case of] a strip!

Tosafot on Chullin 45a:8:1.hebrew: כדי שיכנס איסר לרחבו - פירוש: לרחבו של איסר, שיושיבהו שם על רחבו ויכנס; לאפוקי דרך עוביו:
Tosafot on Chullin 45a:8:1.english: "So that an issar can enter widthwise" - Explanation: [This means] across the width of the issar, that one places it there on its width and it enters; to exclude [entering] by way of its thickness.
